## Running locally

This project uses legacy Angular CLI 7 tooling and is incompatible with Node.js 24. Use Node.js 10.24.1 with the existing dependencies:

```sh
nvm use 10.24.1
npm start
```

Node.js 10 is end-of-life; use it only to run this legacy project locally.

## Firebase setup

The Firebase Web SDK settings are in `src/environments/firebase.config.ts` and are shared by development and production builds. In the Firebase console, create a project, register a Web app, then use that app's SDK configuration in this file. Do not paste a service-account key or other private credentials there.

Enable Google as a sign-in provider under Authentication, and create a Firestore database if you use the app's user data service. Keep Firestore rules restricted to authenticated users and your app's required data. The API key in Firebase's Web SDK configuration identifies the project; it is not a service-account secret.
